MergeParameters.description_en:
Configuration parameters related to stream switching for the queried task.

When a stream disconnection is explicitly detected (EOF or network error), primary/backup switching is triggered immediately.
If the stutter rate exceeds 60% within the last 5 seconds, primary/backup switching is triggered immediately.
If the stream pull times out and no frame data is received for 2 consecutive seconds, primary/backup switching is triggered.
If there is no stream disconnection or stuttering, but the average frame rate within the last ali_max_no_frame_timeout period is less than ali_low_frame_rate_threshold, primary/backup switching is triggered immediately. If the user has set the ali_max_no_frame_timeout parameter, the timeout in rule 3 will also be updated to ali_max_no_frame_timeout.

Enabling block_all_jitter disables rules 2, 3, and 4.

Valid value ranges:

10 > ali_max_no_frame_timeout > 2
200 > ali_low_frame_rate_threshold > 1
block_all_jitter: 0 (disabled by default) or 1 (enabled)
MergeParameters.description_zh:
查询任务所对应的切流相关的配置参数

明确发生断流时（eof 或 net err），立刻触发主备切换；
最近5秒内卡顿率超过60%，立刻触发主备切换；
拉流超时，持续2秒收不到帧数据，触发主备切换；
未断流、未发生卡顿，但是最近ali_max_no_frame_timeout时间内的平均帧率 小于 ali_low_frame_rate_threshold，立刻触发主备切换。如果用户设置了 ali_max_no_frame_timeout 参数，则3的超时时间会同步更新成 ali_max_no_frame_timeout。

开启 block_all_jitter 则2、3、4不生效。

取值范围： 

10 > ali_max_no_frame_timeout > 2；
200 > ali_low_frame_rate_threshold > 1 ；
block_all_jitter的值为0（默认关闭）或 1（开启）
